selection_process: Selection will be based on marks obtained in the relevant qualifying examination. The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination for these apprenticeship slots.
Trade Apprentices will be selected based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination.
Graduate Apprentices will be assessed based on the marks obtained in their Bachelor's degree
following the percentage-calculation procedure of the awarding university or institution.
Where the university has an established CGPA or grade conversion procedure
that procedure will be followed. If no established conversion system is available
the CGPA or grade will be multiplied by 10 to obtain the equivalent percentage. For semester-wise marks without an established aggregate calculation method
the average of the semester-wise percentages will be used. For year-wise marks without an established aggregate calculation method
the average of the year-wise percentages will be used. If two or more candidates have the same percentage at the cut-off
preference will be given to the older candidate based on date of birth.
Candidates may be required to furnish a certificate from their university or institution confirming the equivalent aggregate percentage for CGPA/OGPA-based qualifications.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website of NLC India Limited at www.nlcindia.in.
Open the Careers section and select Trainees & Apprentices.
Find Advertisement No. L&DC/04/2026 for ITI Trade and Graduate (Non-Engineering) Apprenticeship Training.
Click the Apply Online link or open the official apprenticeship application portal.
Enter the personal and educational information requested in the application form.
Select the relevant ITI trade or Graduate (Non-Engineering) discipline.
Upload the prescribed photograph, signature, certificates, marksheets and supporting documents.
Ensure the files comply with the notified formats and size limits.
Submit the online application before 9 November 2026 at 5:00 PM and retain the application confirmation for future reference.
important_instructions: Reservation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS and PwBD candidates will be provided according to the Apprentices Act and applicable provisions.

OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates must provide a valid OBC-NCL certificate in the prescribed Government format, valid from 1 April 2026. Candidates who fail to submit the applicable reservation certificate will be considered under the General category.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: NLC India Limited has issued for 1,067 ITI Trade and Graduate (Non-Engineering) apprenticeship training slots at Neyveli and Regional Office, Chennai. The official four-page notification provides the trade-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, stipend, training duration, selection rules, important dates and document-upload instructions. Official Notification PDF: Download NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the qualification required for their apprenticeship category. Graduate (Non-Engineering) candidates must also meet the prescribed passing-year restriction. Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade from a recognized institute . The notification does not prescribe a qualifying-examination passing-year restriction for ITI candidates. Applicants must possess a regular full-time Bachelor's degree in the relevant discipline from a UGC-approved university . Eligible disciplines include Commerce, Business Administration, Computer Science, Computer Application, Geology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Pharmacy and Nursing, as listed in the vacancy table. Passing Year Requirement: Graduate (Non-Engineering) candidates must have passed their qualifying examination in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 . This restriction does not apply to ITI Trade Apprentice candidates. Applicants must hail from Tamil Nadu or Puducherry. Candidates must have completed 18 years of age on or before 31 October 2026. Candidates who have already undergone or are undergoing NAPS/NATS apprenticeship training or the PM internship scheme at NLC India Limited or elsewhere are not eligible under the notification. Graduate applicants must have a regular full-time degree in the corresponding discipline. Candidates claiming reservation must produce valid certificates in the prescribed Government format.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age for NLC India Apprenticeship Training 2026 is 18 years as on 31 October 2026 , under Section 3(a) of the Apprentices Act, 1961.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend between Rs. 12,000 and Rs. 16,678 , depending on their training category and discipline. For Graduate Apprentices, the notified stipend includes Rs. 6,150 payable by the Government through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme . The stipend is paid during the prescribed 12-month apprenticeship training period. These are training stipends, not regular employee salary scales.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The notified training locations are Neyveli and Regional Office, Chennai. Completion of apprenticeship training does not provide any right to temporary or permanent employment with NLC India Limited.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on marks obtained in the relevant qualifying examination . The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination for these apprenticeship slots. Trade Apprentices will be selected based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination. Graduate Apprentices will be assessed based on the marks obtained in their Bachelor's degree, following the percentage-calculation procedure of the awarding university or institution. Where the university has an established CGPA or grade conversion procedure, that procedure will be followed. If no established conversion system is available, the CGPA or grade will be multiplied by 10 to obtain the equivalent percentage. For semester-wise marks without an established aggregate calculation method, the average of the semester-wise percentages will be used. For year-wise marks without an established aggregate calculation method, the average of the year-wise percentages will be used. If two or more candidates have the same percentage at the cut-off, preference will be given to the older candidate based on date of birth. Candidates may be required to furnish a certificate from their university or institution confirming the equivalent aggregate percentage for CGPA/OGPA-based qualifications.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Apply Online: NLC India ITI and Graduate Apprentice Online Application Last Date: 9 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Candidates should read the notification and complete all mandatory details and document uploads before final submission.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important for 2026 Graduates: Candidates who completed their course in 2026 but have not received their Provisional Certificate may submit a Temporary Provisional Certificate in the prescribed format. It must be issued on the institution's official letterhead and signed and sealed by the Principal. Graduate applicants must include relevant semester-wise or consolidated marksheets and the CGPA/OGPA conversion certificate, where applicable. ITI applicants must include the relevant trade certificate and marksheets in the prescribed merged file.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Reservation Rules
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS and PwBD candidates will be provided according to the Apprentices Act and applicable provisions. OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates must provide a valid OBC-NCL certificate in the prescribed Government format, valid from 1 April 2026 . Candidates who fail to submit the applicable reservation certificate will be considered under the General category.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Neyveli Lignite Corporation India (NLC India) for filling various ITI and Graduate (Non-Engineering) apprenticeship positions across multiple disciplines under Advt. No. L&DC/04/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in NLC India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 1067 vacancies available for ITI and Graduate (Non-Engineering) Apprentices across various trades including Fitter, Electrician, Commerce, Computer Science, and Nursing.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting and last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 21 October 2026 and the last date to successfully submit the online application form is 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Trade Apprentices?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade from a recognized institute to be eligible for the Trade Apprentice positions offered by NLC India.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for Graduate Non-Engineering Apprentices?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a regular full-time Bachelor's degree in the relevant discipline from a UGC-approved university, such as B.Com, BBA, BCA, B.Sc, or B.Pharm.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to these apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have attained a minimum age of 18 years, which must be completed on or before 31 October 2026, as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly stipend/salary provided during the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Selected ITI Apprentices receive Rs. 12,000/- per month, while Graduate Apprentices receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 14,174/- to Rs. 16,678/- depending on their specific post.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for these apprenticeship positions?
faq.answer: Selection is completely merit-based, determined by the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination for Trade Apprentices and Bachelor's Degree for Graduate Apprentices.

faq.question: Q9. Are candidates from all states eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates hailing from the states of Tamil Nadu and Puducherry are exclusively eligible to apply for this apprenticeship training program at NLC India.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the apprenticeship training?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training duration for all selected candidates across various trades and graduate disciplines is fixed for a period of 12 months.
